title: Mouse wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 36,34 64,34' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 43,20 57,20' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 47,14 53,14' fill='#4fd2ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='14' ry='4' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='4' fill='#4fd2ff'/>

  <!-- Mouse body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#8a6a4f'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#c9a982'/>

  <!-- Mouse head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='18' fill='#a07c5b'/>

  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='43' r='12' fill='#a07c5b'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='43' r='7' fill='#ffb3c9'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='43' r='12' fill='#a07c5b'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='43' r='7' fill='#ffb3c9'/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='53' r='4' fill='#2a2140'/>

  <!-- Nose -->

  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <line x1='36' y1='58' x2='20' y2='54' stroke='#e8d5bc' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='62' x2='19' y2='63' stroke='#e8d5bc' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='58' x2='80' y2='54' stroke='#e8d5bc' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='62' x2='81' y2='63' stroke='#e8d5bc' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M74 85 Q90 82 86 68' fill='none' stroke='#c9a982' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
